description: Principal cycle network - Queensland is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Transport and Main Roads. The Principal Cycle Network shows core routes needed to make it easy to use the bicycle as an everyday form of transport. Coverage: Transport and Main Roads. The portal files it under the publisher Transport and Main Roads. Its tags are bicycle, maps and spatial data, transport. It offers 2 resource(s) in SHP, TAB, FGDB, KMZ, GPKG, XML. The portal shows 2025-11-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
